title: RC16 Compression-Specific Long Alpha versus Same-Clock Drift

research_height.transfer_path: The native micro compression decision is contrasted with same-clock long controls; only a broad compression-specific response changes the meso component's alpha classification and macro expectation under non-rising markets.

central_question: At the frozen 13:30 clock, does RC16's long compression signal add material eight-bar value above both unconditional US30 long drift and positive-recent-direction days that fail compression, across independent 2025 and completed-month 2026 periods?

research_bundle.name: native_signal_unconditional_long_and_direction_matched_compression_contrast
lenses: mechanism: signal-day versus every same-clock no-signal day's ATR-normalized eight-bar return and positive-rate difference
natural control: signal-day versus positive-recent-direction but subthreshold-compression days, isolating compression from simple directional filtering
breadth and adverse-path falsification: fixed calendar-month excess signs plus median MAE across both independent periods

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 064 found that a favorable signed common market path can carry strategy return, while Unit 065 found only 10.01% daily portfolio benchmark mapping. Neither distinguishes RC16's mandatory long direction from its compression condition.
why_now.connection_bridge: RC16 is long-only, contributed materially to retained portfolio economics, and Unit 063 already validated exact 13:30 feature parity and preserved the complete same-clock US30 path needed for a no-acquisition contrast.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 069 was Program 4 micro-to-macro capital/stop feedback. Unit 070 moves to Program 1 meso signal identity, uses a same-clock market-path control rather than lifecycle capital tails, and tests pre-entry selectivity rather than post-entry risk geometry.
why_now.decision_if_complete: Classify RC16 as having compression-specific long alpha in the observed periods and strengthen preservation of its existing signal identity; do not change allocation or Live automatically.
why_now.decision_if_direction_only: Classify the component as more than passive beta but not specifically validated as compression alpha; preserve it without a compression-strength seed or implementation candidate.
why_now.decision_if_no_signal_excess: Record beta-dependent expectation for RC16 and lower confidence in extrapolation to flat or falling regimes, without removing or resizing it from this partial-window evidence.
why_now.decision_if_invalid_or_sparse: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away without a rescue.

frozen_reconstruction.evaluation_clock: 13:30 only; no absent day or slot is synthesized
frozen_reconstruction.information_set: At evaluation index i use exactly the 112 completed available M30 bars i-112 through i-1 and require open i+8.
frozen_reconstruction.feature: Reproduce Unit 063 exactly: median of 96 rolling 16-bar log ranges, current completed 16-bar log range, log(close[111]/close[103]) direction, signed_tightness=sign(direction)/compression_ratio, signal when signed_tightness >= 1.5.
frozen_reconstruction.atr: Arithmetic ATR14 from the fourteen completed bars immediately before evaluation using true range against the preceding completed close.
frozen_reconstruction.contrast_interval: Difference in arithmetic means, SIGNAL minus control, with fixed normal 95% interval difference +/- 1.96*sqrt(sample_variance_signal/n_signal + sample_variance_control/n_control).
frozen_reconstruction.positive_rate: Share of forward_return_atr strictly greater than zero; report SIGNAL minus control.
frozen_reconstruction.monthly_breadth: Within each calendar month require at least two SIGNAL and five observations in the relevant control. Report the unweighted median monthly excess and fraction of valid months with excess strictly positive.

requirements: All input byte/hash pins and 19,604 unique increasing bar rows pass.
Exact Unit 063 native topology and prior evidence reproduce: 258/151 eligible rows, 79/39 SIGNAL rows, signal means and MAE medians within 1e-12.
Each period has at least 30 SIGNAL, 80 unconditional controls and 30 positive-direction no-compression controls.
Monthly breadth has at least six valid 2025 months and four valid 2026 months for both control contrasts.
SIGNAL minus unconditional-control mean forward return is at least 0.20 ATR in each period.
The pooled normal 95% interval lower bound for that excess is strictly positive.
SIGNAL minus unconditional-control positive-rate difference is at least 0.05 in each period.
SIGNAL median MAE is no more than unconditional-control median MAE plus 0.25 ATR in each period.
SIGNAL minus positive-direction no-compression mean forward return is at least 0.10 ATR in each period.
The pooled normal 95% interval lower bound for that excess is strictly positive.
SIGNAL minus positive-direction-control positive-rate difference is at least 0.03 in each period.
Monthly median excess is strictly positive and at least 60% of valid months have positive excess in each period.
SIGNAL median MAE is no more than positive-direction-control median MAE plus 0.25 ATR in each period.

fixed_verdict_rules.complete: PASS_RC16_COMPRESSION_SPECIFIC_LONG_ALPHA_PRESERVE_COMPONENT_CONVICTION when integrity/density, unconditional-long excess and compression-specificity gates all pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.direction_only: PARTIAL_RC16_LONG_DIRECTION_VALUE_WITHOUT_COMPRESSION_SPECIFICITY_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity/density and unconditional-long excess pass but compression-specificity fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_signal_excess: NO_MATERIAL_RC16_SIGNAL_EXCESS_CLASSIFY_BETA_DEPENDENT_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity/density pass but unconditional-long excess fails and both unconditional controls have positive mean forward return.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_RC16_SIGNAL_VERSUS_LONG_DRIFT_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity/density pass but the observations fit none of the preceding rules.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid_or_sparse: INVALID_OR_SPARSE_RC16_SIGNAL_SPECIFICITY_NO_VERDICT when any immutable reconstruction or density requirement fails.

decision_translation.complete: Preserve RC16 with stronger compression-specific economic interpretation; retain no new implementation because RC16 already exists.
decision_translation.direction_only: Preserve RC16 but do not attribute the observed excess specifically to compression and retain no threshold or allocation seed.
decision_translation.no_signal_excess: Preserve current behavior while recording beta-dependent expectation and lower transfer confidence outside rising regimes; retain no removal or sizing candidate.
decision_translation.ambiguous_or_invalid: Record the bounded observation gap and rotate away.

stop_rules: Commit and push declaration, state and Frontier memory before calculating any control mean, excess interval, positive-rate difference or monthly contrast.
One implementation-only correction is permitted only before any new control or contrast outcome is emitted. After any new metric, make no correction or rerun.
Do not change the period, clock, feature, threshold, controls, response, month density or gate after outcomes.
Do not acquire data, create a runtime, modify MQL, compile, run Tester, query broker/account state or touch Live.
